# A sunflower seed pickup. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Seed --base-color 0.984 0.949 0.212 --no-slot
material new Stripe --base-color 0.541 0.435 0.188 --no-slot
add mesh uv-sphere --segments 8 --rings 6 --radius 0.5 --name S --location 0 0 0
scale 0.17 0.1 0.28
apply --scale
apply --location
material assign Seed
active S
mode edit
select vert where "pos.z > 0.08"
scale 0.55 0.55 1.25
select face where "pos.x < 0.03 && pos.x > -0.03"
material assign Stripe
mode object
select all
shade flat
export seed.glb
